title: Echoes of Yesterday
genre: Action Thriller / Science Fiction / Time Travel Drama
premise: An elderly man travels back in time to the 1980s and encounters his seventeen-year-old self. As he attempts to prevent a tragedy that shaped his entire life, he discovers that changing the past may destroy the future he remembers. Pursued by a dangerous criminal enforcer and forced to confront the choices he once made, he must decide whether to protect his younger self or allow history to unfold.

visualTone.description: A cinematic 1980s time-travel thriller combining grounded period authenticity, atmospheric science fiction, gritty urban action and emotionally intimate character drama. The visual language contrasts the cold, desaturated present with the warmer, textured world of the 1980s. Practical lighting, atmospheric haze, strong silhouettes, motivated highlights and carefully controlled camera movement create a realistic Hollywood feature-film aesthetic.

cinematography.lightingPhilosophy: Motivated practical lighting with warm tungsten sources in the 1980s environments, cool moonlight and industrial fluorescent lighting in darker locations. Use realistic shadow falloff, volumetric atmospheric haze, controlled backlighting and subtle lens flares. Avoid artificial-looking illumination.
cinematography.filmStock: Kodak Vision3 500T aesthetic with subtle organic film grain, natural highlight roll-off, rich blacks and restrained halation.
cinematography.visualEffects: Photorealistic temporal displacement effects, subtle electromagnetic distortion, practical sparks, realistic smoke and atmospheric light interaction. Avoid cartoon-like effects, excessive glowing interfaces and exaggerated science-fiction imagery.

audioStyle.music: A cinematic hybrid score combining atmospheric synthesizers, restrained analog 1980s electronic textures, orchestral tension and emotional piano themes.
audioStyle.soundDesign: Detailed environmental ambience, mechanical sounds, distant traffic, electrical interference, footsteps, wind, industrial reverberation and realistic physical impacts.
audioStyle.dialogueStyle: Naturalistic performances with restrained emotional delivery. Dialogue should feel grounded, conversational and appropriate to the characters' ages and circumstances.

sets.name: Abandoned Research Laboratory
sets.description: A forgotten underground research facility hidden beneath an abandoned industrial building. The laboratory contains stained concrete walls, exposed electrical conduits, rusted metal support beams, old computer terminals, analog monitoring equipment, dusty workbenches and scattered technical documents. At its centre stands an experimental temporal displacement apparatus assembled from industrial machinery, copper wiring, magnetic coils and a reinforced metal platform. Cold fluorescent lights flicker overhead while emergency red indicators illuminate sections of the room. Dust hangs in the air, and the atmosphere feels isolated, dangerous and technologically primitive.
sets.lighting: Cold fluorescent overhead lighting mixed with intermittent red warning lights and concentrated blue-white illumination from the temporal apparatus.
sets.colorTreatment: Cold blue-grey shadows, dirty concrete neutrals and occasional red highlights.

sets.name: 1985 Suburban Family Home
sets.description: A modest suburban family house preserved in authentic mid-1980s style. The living room features patterned wallpaper, dark wooden furniture, a bulky CRT television, a VHS player, cassette tapes, family photographs, a rotary telephone and a faded patterned sofa. Warm table lamps illuminate the room, while soft daylight enters through lace curtains. The house feels lived-in and emotionally significant, representing the childhood and family life that elderly Arthur has spent decades remembering. Small imperfections, worn carpets and period-appropriate domestic objects establish a convincing 1985 environment.
sets.lighting: Warm tungsten table lamps combined with soft natural daylight through the windows.
sets.atmosphere: Nostalgic, intimate, familiar and emotionally charged.
sets.colorTreatment: Warm faded gold, brown wood, muted greens and natural cream tones.

sets.name: 1980s Downtown Street
sets.description: A busy urban street in the mid-1980s, lined with brick storefronts, independent shops, old cinemas, diners and weathered commercial buildings. Period-correct vehicles occupy the road, including boxy sedans, station wagons and older delivery vans. Shop windows display hand-painted signs, neon lettering and vintage advertisements. Pedestrians wear authentic 1980s clothing, including denim jackets, leather coats, tracksuits and colourful knitwear. The pavement is slightly wet, reflecting shop lights and passing vehicle headlights. The street provides an authentic backdrop for a tense confrontation and pursuit.
sets.lighting: Overcast afternoon daylight transitioning into warm storefront illumination and neon reflections.
sets.atmosphere: Lively, gritty, unpredictable and increasingly threatening.
sets.colorTreatment: Muted urban neutrals contrasted with faded neon reds, greens and amber.

sets.name: Riverside Industrial Warehouse
sets.description: A neglected industrial warehouse beside a dark river, surrounded by rusted shipping containers, loading bays, cracked concrete and abandoned machinery. Inside, enormous steel support columns rise toward a high corrugated roof. Old wooden crates, metal shelving, industrial chains and damaged equipment create deep layers of foreground and background detail. Narrow windows admit cold shafts of moonlight, while isolated industrial lamps cast hard pools of yellow illumination across the floor. The warehouse has an exposed loading area overlooking the river, allowing characters to move between shadowy interiors and the open industrial exterior.
sets.lighting: Cold moonlight through high windows, isolated industrial tungsten lamps and occasional vehicle headlights entering through the loading bay.
sets.colorTreatment: Deep midnight blue, weathered green, rusty brown and isolated warm highlights.

sets.name: Abandoned Railway Platform
sets.description: A deserted railway platform at the edge of a small industrial town. The station has aged brickwork, weathered wooden benches, old metal signage, a faded timetable board and vintage platform lamps. Two parallel railway tracks disappear into the darkness beyond the station. Tall grass grows between sections of cracked concrete, and a light mist drifts across the rails. The platform feels suspended in time, providing a quiet and emotionally powerful setting for the final encounter between the elderly man and his younger self.
sets.lighting: Soft amber platform lamps, cold blue moonlight and subtle atmospheric haze.
sets.atmosphere: Melancholic, peaceful, mysterious and emotionally resonant.
sets.colorTreatment: Faded gold highlights, midnight blue shadows and weathered grey textures.

characters.name: Arthur Bennett
characters.description: An elderly man with a weathered face, deep-set blue-grey eyes, pronounced forehead lines, silver-grey hair and a neatly trimmed grey beard. His expression reveals decades of regret, exhaustion and unresolved grief. He has a lean build and slightly stooped posture, but his eyes remain alert and intelligent. His movements are measured and deliberate, revealing a man whose body has aged while his determination remains intact. He carries the emotional burden of a life-changing event from his youth and believes that travelling back in time may give him one final opportunity to change his destiny.

His expressions are more spontaneous and emotionally transparent than those of his elderly counterpart. His face must clearly resemble elderly Arthur, with matching eye shape, nose structure, jawline and distinctive scar above the right eyebrow.

characters.name: Daniel Mercer
characters.description: A physically imposing criminal enforcer with a broad build, short dark hair, cold brown eyes and a rough, intimidating face. His expression is controlled and threatening, with a faint scar running along his left cheek. He moves with confidence and calculated aggression. He is connected to a criminal operation that Young Arthur becomes involved with during the 1980s. Mercer believes that fear and violence are the most effective ways to control people. His presence creates an immediate sense of danger whenever he enters a scene.

characters.name: Eleanor Bennett
characters.description: A warm but emotionally resilient woman with shoulder-length chestnut-brown hair, expressive hazel eyes and a natural, understated appearance. She is a significant part of Arthur's family history and represents the emotional connections that shaped his youth. She is perceptive, compassionate and strong-willed, capable of recognising when something is wrong even when people attempt to conceal it. Her presence grounds the story in ordinary family life and gives the time-travel narrative an emotional centre.

characters.name: Detective Samuel Reeves
characters.description: An experienced police detective with a serious expression, short greying brown hair, tired green eyes and a solid average build. His face shows years of investigative work and exposure to violence. He is methodical, observant and difficult to deceive. He is investigating the criminal activity surrounding Daniel Mercer and gradually becomes suspicious of the unusual circumstances surrounding Arthur Bennett. He represents the law and the ordinary world attempting to make sense of events that cannot easily be explained.

shots.title: The Last Experiment
shots.description: Inside [Set1], [Role1] stands alone beside [Prop1], the experimental temporal displacement device. His dark charcoal overcoat hangs loosely from his shoulders as he studies the machine's analogue control panel. He slowly places one hand against the reinforced metal housing, then activates the device. The circular magnetic chamber begins to vibrate, electrical arcs flash between exposed copper coils and intense white-blue light spreads across the laboratory. His face is illuminated by the rapidly intensifying energy as the room begins to distort around him.

roleActions.action: Studies the temporal displacement device, places one hand on its metal housing and activates the control mechanism. He braces himself as the machine begins to generate an intense electrical field.

shots.title: A Face from the Past
shots.description: Inside [Set2], [Role1] stands in the familiar living room, visibly overwhelmed by the surroundings he has not seen for decades. Warm afternoon sunlight filters through the curtains, illuminating the family photographs and period furniture. He looks down at [Prop3], the old family photograph held carefully in his hand. Across the room, [Role2] enters wearing his faded denim jacket and notices the strange elderly visitor. The two versions of Arthur stare at one another in disbelief, recognising the same eyes, facial structure and distinctive scar. The younger man takes a cautious step forward while the elderly man struggles to contain his emotions.

shots.title: The Man from the Shadows
shots.description: On [Set3], [Role2] walks along the busy 1980s street while [Role1] follows a short distance behind. Period-correct cars move through the background and neon shop signs reflect across the slightly wet pavement. [Role2] suddenly notices [Role3] standing beside a parked car, watching him with a cold expression. Daniel steps away from the vehicle and approaches the younger man. Elderly Arthur recognises the dangerous situation immediately and looks down at [Prop2], the vintage wristwatch on his wrist, before moving quickly to intervene. The street atmosphere changes from ordinary urban activity to imminent danger.

Elderly Arthur steps between Daniel and his younger self, attempting to prevent the confrontation from becoming violent. The detective watches carefully, uncertain whether to arrest the men or uncover the truth behind their strange connection.

shots.title: The Last Goodbye
shots.description: On [Set5], [Role1] and [Role2] stand facing one another beside the old railway tracks. A pale dawn sky casts soft blue light across the deserted platform while warm amber lamps remain illuminated behind them. Elderly Arthur looks at [Prop2], his vintage wristwatch, then carefully places [Prop3], the family photograph, into the younger man's hand. Young Arthur studies the photograph and looks back at the old man, beginning to understand the significance of their encounter. The two versions of Arthur share a final silent moment. The elderly man turns toward the distant tracks, leaving his younger self standing alone on the platform as the morning light gradually grows brighter.
